aplicacao_citacao: p.393, Sec.4 (Case study): 'WYNG Gardens, a student residential block for Trinity Hall College, Cambridge ... 4 storeys above ground'; Tab.2: 'RC columns and RC flat slab' (RC25/30) e laje hibrida precast RC40/50.
nota: Calculo A1-A3 (+A4, A5, C por coeficientes) sem fases B; nenhuma vida util em anos no artigo. Sec.2 so menciona 'service life of building products, assumed life of the building (also known as reference study period)' como fontes de discrepancia citadas de Anand e Amor [23], sem numero.

citadas.citacao: p.10, Sec.4 (Discussion and conclusions): 'It is widely assumed that buildings have a life cycle of 50 years. Using wood in buildings saves biomass, which will also continue to increase at each round of 50 years.'

aplicacao_citacao: p.3, Sec.2.2: 'The case building is a modern educational facility at the University of Iceland in Reykjavik ... Veroeld'; Sec.2.3.1: 'most building components (i.e., column and beams, structural external and internal walls, non-structural walls, and slabs) were reinforced concrete'.
nota: Fronteira A1-A4 (pre-uso), sem vida util propria. Os 50 anos aparecem so na discussao, como pressuposto generico sobre edificios, sem fonte citada (por isso base 'literatura' com fonte nao identificada; pode tratar-se como valor citado fraco).

declarada.citacao: p.3, Sec.2.1.3 (Functional unit and system boundary): 'The building reference service life was assumed to be 50 years.'

aplicacao_citacao: p.2, Sec.2.1.1: 'A slab was therefore selected as a target component ... The location of the construction project was limited to Korea, and the slab was designed to follow Korean Design Standard (KDS)'; laje de edificio (comparacao RC/CLT/TCC).
nota: Valor gravado (50) confirmado. Premissa sem norma nem estudo citado; fronteira A1-A3, por isso a vida util nao entra no calculo.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.2.1: 'beams made of reinforced concrete with a constant rectangular cross-section, which are usually applied in building and industrial construction'; Sec.2.3: 'the system boundaries include the manufacturing of prefabricated beams'; 'lengths of 4.0, 8.0 and 12.0 m to represent different applications in the building construction sector'.
nota: Nenhuma vida util em anos: so 'ensuring service during the whole expected lifetime' e exposicao a carbonatacao sem modelo. Instalacao e uso excluidos. Aplicacao: vigas pre-fabricadas para edificios (alternativa 'edificio').

declarada.citacao: Resumo: 'comparative LCA and LCCA of three composite columns over a service life of 100 years'; Sec.3: 'To cover major maintenance actions for each alternative, FHWA [80] has suggested the investigated time period to be as long as enough. In balance, the life-cycle assessment herein is conducted over a period of 100 years.'

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.2: coluna CFST de referencia de [32]: '1. Consider a slab in a three-story building with panel dimension of 10 x 20 m2 ... 3. Transform dead and live loads into uniaxial load on a column of 5,622 kN'; CFFT e DSTC dimensionados para a mesma carga.
nota: Valor gravado (100, ambos os pares) confirmado. O FHWA e citado so para justificar um periodo 'long enough', nao fixa os 100 anos, por isso base 'premissa_sem_fonte'. Intervalos de manutencao (10 anos CFST, 20 anos CFFT/DSTC) vem de modelos de deterioracao de outros estudos [81-83], mas nao sao vida util. A introducao refere CFFT em pilares de pontes como uso geral, mas o caso estudado e coluna de edificio.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.2: vigas de laboratorio 100x125x1200 mm sem armadura transversal; Sec.5: 'a cradle-to-gate assessment was performed to estimate the CO2-eq emissions arising from the production of the beams contained in the database'; nenhum elemento/obra de destino declarado.
nota: Nenhuma mencao a vida util ou durabilidade em anos. ACV cradle-to-gate.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.2.6: 'RAC mixes studied in this paper are feasible for structural applications such as beams, slabs, and columns in buildings'; Sec.2.4: betoes de referencia 'typically used in flexural members such as slabs and beams (31.5 MPa) ... and in members primarily subjected to compression such as columns (51.3 MPa)'.
nota: Cradle-to-gate (A1-A3), sem vida util. O artigo tambem diz que os betoes servem 'load-bearing structures such as buildings and bridges as well as subgrade applications such as pavements' e 'structural members of buildings and infrastructure in Colombia'; escolhido 'edificio' por ser a aplicacao mais especifica e repetida.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.2.2: 'we aimed to target the conventional concrete of 28 MPa, widely used in residential and frame-structure constructions worldwide'; Sec.2.5: 'The functional unit is 1 m3 of ready-mixed concrete' (A1-A3).
nota: Estudo de material em laboratorio (cilindros 150x300), sem vida util nem durabilidade em anos. A frase da Sec.2.2 descreve o uso habitual da classe 28 MPa (residencial/porticos); se se aceitar como aplicacao declarada, seria 'edificio'.

aplicacao_citacao: Tab.1/Sec.2.2: hotel de 12 pisos em Saihat (Provincia Oriental, Arabia Saudita), 'Structural material: Reinforcement concrete'; estudo das colunas de betao armado do edificio.
nota: Confirma a nota gravada: Sec.2.6 so refere 'the Reference Service Life stipulated in modules B2, B4, B6, and B7 of EN 15804' sem numero; analise limitada a A1-A5. Fig.9 (esquema cradle-to-grave adaptado de [32]) nao foi renderizada (PDF de 10,4 MB, acima do limite de download); o texto da legenda e a nota de 2026-09-19 indicam que nao tem valor.

aplicacao_citacao: Resumo: 'The framework was assessed through the examination of a newly constructed highway in South Georgia ... 11.52 linear miles (18.54 linear km) of pavement'; Sec.3.1.1: I-75 Dooly County, betao Class 1 de pavimento e bermas.
nota: Cradle-to-gate; nenhuma vida util em anos. So o objectivo qualitativo 'develop a pavement that will yield a longer in-place service life' (Sec.1).
